name: Jim Jordan
subject: This letter comes entirely from the heart
body:
| _**A Letter from the Desk of Chairman Jim Jordan**_
---
Dear Friend,
---
_THANK YOU._
---
Those two simple words are not said enough by elected officials.
---
**Taking on the Deep State, the Washington Swamp, and the Radical Left is no easy feat...**
---
...But it makes it a heck of a lot easier knowing that grassroots conservatives like __you__ have my back.
---
And that’s not just some empty platitude. It’s the honest-to-God truth.
---
_While the Left has Big Money, Big Media, and Big Government on its side, our America First movement is powered by the millions of hardworking citizens who truly run America._
---
Right now, we’re just about 50 DAYS out from the most important election of our lifetime – **and we know perfectly well the Democrats are going to try and pull every dirty trick they can to stop us.**
---
_They’re even preparing to spend**$1 BILLION** to buy the White House and Congress – **_and you know they’d love to see me gone from the House!_**_
---
But here’s my response to the Democrats and the Deep State... _**Bring. It. On.**_
---
With grassroots patriots like _YOU_ by my side, I have full faith that we can prevail against anything and everything the Democrats throw our way.
---
**So, if you can contribute anything for the final 50 days of the election, I know it would mean the world to our movement.**
---
But if you can’t contribute right now because times are tough in Biden’s America, please don’t think twice. Take care of yourself and your family now – and very soon, America’s going to come roaring back.
---
[**Please make a grassroots contribution, and together, let’s show the Left that NOTHING can stop us!**](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=6530786.923.1.85b2e303c8d252bc5943cc5e35434142)
---

[CONTRIBUTE $25 >> ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=6530786.924.1.abf0a973fee0734569b713798df51c78)
---

---

---

[CONTRIBUTE OTHER AMOUNT >>](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=6530786.929.1.de91414b1434a1fa028766714617dd89)
---

Thank you and onward to victory,
---

---
Jim Jordan

Straight from the Brennan Center: " Imagine you’re an undocumented person living in the United States. You’ve come to this country seeking a better life for you and your family. Or maybe your parents brought you here seeking the same when you were a child. You spend your life living in very real fear that you might be noticed by the government and be deported — perhaps to a country you’ve never known. " Anything you might do that could get you found out and sent away is likely not worth the risk -- including attempting to illegally vote.
Opponents of voting rights want to feed on all our fears to win elections.
We must not fear our fundamental right to vote or believe the lies and demonization about noncitizens. Chip in $25 or more today to educate the public about our elections and protect voting rights nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092124_1&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092124_1&amount=25]
Brennan Center for Justice: Noncitizens Are Not Voting in Federal or State Elections [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092124_1&amount=25]
You're being lied to, Team. Plain and simple.
Time and again, it's been proven that noncitizens are not voting in our state or federal elections. All states -- across the country -- have multiple systems in place to stop attempted noncitizen voting. Noncitizens who violate the law face prison time and deportation.
Why is a major, partisan news network plus a major political party and multiple candidates lying about this? Because they want to scare you into voting for them and the anti-immigration nationalist movement.
What's worse? Every day people reach out to us, asking about lies regarding noncitizen voting, like how some states are paying for hotel rooms and busing in noncitizens to vote. It's all lies . It's been investigated and disproven over and over again by journalists and nonpartisan organizations -- noncitizens who try and vote are caught and convicted, and noncitizen votes don't count in federal and state elections.
The people who peddle these lies are trying to use you. They want your fear to control you and make you vote for their anti-democracy agenda, searching for safety in their controlling, suppressive, fascistic arms.
Team: We can't abide these lies and we cannot stand by while our elections are slandered and distrust is sown. Fight back against these wicked lies and pitch in $25 or whatever you can to help us educate voters about the truth nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092124_1&amount=25]

This is all a cynical, partisan, racist ploy to make voters afraid to vote and to sow doubt in our election results. Opponents of voting rights only want their kind of voters to show up, and they don't think you should believe the election results unless they win.
Our democracy is at stake -- we cannot let the vote suppressors make us fear our fundamental right to vote or deny that right to other Americans. body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=3786%2E35263%2E5Opu_E ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter — In a
moment, [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep24.J2i10d&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240921_PM3_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=3786%2E35263%2E5Opu_E ]I’ll ask you to make a donation to help me win my most
competitive reelection yet. But first, I want to tell you more about how I
got here.

When I came out in college, I knew that I wanted to pursue a career in
public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice
between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life
openly.

Seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by
coming out, celebrating who they are, and being proud about who they love
helped me realize that I could do both. I could both run for office and be
honest about who I am.

So thanks to the support of this remarkable team, I was elected as the
first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. But I didn’t run for
office to make history,
Peter — I ran to make a
difference.

I knew that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a
difference in people's lives. Folks like you supported me because you
wanted to make a difference, too. And together, we’ve made incredible
progress — but our work isn’t over yet.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass
harmful anti-LGBTQ+ legislation, especially targeting the transgender
community and LGBTQ+ youth. And Eric Hovde, my right-wing opponent, and
Republican extremists threaten to advance a dangerous agenda that has made
anti-LGBTQ+ policies the hallmark of their platform if they succeed to
take back control of the Senate.

Together, we can fight back against harmful policies that do nothing but
divide us, and with your support, I can continue to make a difference in
the lives of the folks I represent. But it’s going to take all of us as I
face my toughest reelection fight yet.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: “Shifty Schiff has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of the most despicable and disgusting elected officials in Congress.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Team — you can hear the spitting anger and desperation from Donald Trump’s campaign in their increasingly desperate attacks.
As they frantically search for something, anything they can tether to a coherent campaign message with time running out until this election, they picked a familiar target — yours truly.

“ Shifty Schiff has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of the most despicable and disgusting elected officials in Congress.”
All because I called Trump out on CNN for flip-flopping on the fundamental right to abortion — no less than 4 times in 48 hours. His willingness to change his stance every 15 minutes on a matter this serious shows that in addition to opposing women’s reproductive freedoms, he has no moral compass or values at all. He only believes in his own self-interest.

But as Trump’s spokesperson saw it, that wasn’t an indictment of their candidate, but of those willing to confront him — the same old story for Trump’s entire political career.

I’m used to the attacks from Trump personally, team. And now, I need your help to respond to his campaign flacks. Every time he and his team come after me, their insults and lies multiply through their right-wing echo chambers and risk having voters believe them.
Team, the Trump campaign is backed into a corner. They are lashing out because they cannot do anything else. Their candidate has no values, no morals, and, we hope, is on the verge of his final defeat.

Chip in a split donation right now between Kirsten Gillibrand's and my campaign to help send me to the Senate and finish the job of defeating him by electing California’s Kamala Harris as our next president. Let’s protect reproductive freedom once and for all.
DONATE: https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_4_schiff?refcode=5418-bu-text&amounts=25,50,100,250,500

If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Adam Schiff and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately:
DONATE: https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_4_schiff?refcode=5418-bu-text?express_lane=true&amounts=25,50,100,250,500

Thank you for your support.
— Adam

A note from Kirsten:

Team, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever.
While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority.
As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. So please, chip in to help defend our narrow Democratic Senate majority. And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, text JOIN to 60708.

Thank you,
Kirsten Gillibrand

body:
Latest endorsement for Peter Hernandez revealed. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ea2c75d6de94/watch-now-electoral-forum-campaign-updates-10346302?e=638e6c2751)

|
# Has the Government Gone Too Far?
---
| Having faced many challenges growing up as the child of migrant workers, my heart has always gone out to the troubled youth I identified with. In 2014, hoping to make an impact on the lives of these youth, I ran and was elected to the Hollister School Board.
At one of my first school board meetings, we were asked to approve routine agenda items including changing the word **PUPIL** to **STUDENT** in all of the district’s governing documents to “align with the state of California”. This was a slight-of-hand effort by the government to strip parents of their rights. The definition of **PUPIL** is _**a person under a guardian (i.e. parent)**_. The definition of **STUDENT** is _**one who attends classes at school (i.e. no parent permission required)**_.
Erin Friday, a local attorney and parental rights advocate, found how devastating this little terminology change played out when she was summoned to her daughter’s school. Her child had an important announcement. Backed up and encouraged by the school counselors, Erin’s daughter announced that “she” was now a “he” and this was “his” new name. Erin was devastated but was warned that if she tried to transition her child back, the child would commit suicide.
**When they come after our children,****the government has gone too far.**
Because of Erin’s experience, and that of countless other parents, I boldly stand for parental rights. My billboards say, **“When they come after our children, the government has gone too far.”** This wording might seem too strong, but when schools secretly transition children and hide that from parents... they have gone too far.
As a Democrat, Erin first tried to reach out to Democrat legislators to get safeguards in place for children. She was totally rebuffed. It was Republican legislators including State Senator Shannon Grove and Assemblyman Bill Essayli who have tried to help.
Today Erin is part of _Our Duty_ , a worldwide organization fighting on behalf of parents and children. You can read and join her Substack here: [https://tinyurl.com/OurDutySubstack](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=53513f097b&e=638e6c2751).
Although still registered as a Democrat, Erin Friday has endorsed me for Congress and is making clear that Democrats need to support Republican candidates to bring an end to this gender turmoil with our kids.
---
[](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=8b00d428bf&e=638e6c2751)
| _"I support Peter Hernandez. He is pro-family and supports transparency in schools. His adversary, Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren, has been in office since 1995. She pretends to care about “ our daughters & granddaughters,” yet she is an advocate for males who believe that they are women and can enter and participate as females in sports and gain entrance into female-only spaces, and calling Gail Heriot of the US Commission on Civil Rights a “bigot” for believing in biologic reality.”_Erin Friday, Esq.
---
| I am proud that activist Democrats like Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh, who ran against Zoe Lofgren in the March Primary, and Erin Friday have both endorsed me for Congress.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | I need to put up more billboards with this message which resonates with parents regardless of party affiliation. Can you please donate and help me get the message out. We must stand up for children and parental rights, and my opponent will never support that! Thank you for your support.
---

I got a few free minutes this morning

I got a few free minutes this morning...

| | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;_tc=AB-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._ftI6Rdqxmng)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-si4C9DLw)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._f7wb8wy8g)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-Xj0t4klU0GVbzo40m_g)

subject: Take our Critical Race Theory Survey
body:
I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zq156r7507is2b1hj681d6ejhmgglbggqlj5rtv8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjie9oj5cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztpubpojgqivlttsepapailnieobn613b73nuq1g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjie9oj5cth2bs)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmkos4s731cumjh7b3mb2114m5dhohinck65nhc8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjie9oj5cth2bs)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

body:

| | |
---
I got a few free minutes this morning...

---
| | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-TTN&utm;_tc=TTN-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.
We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.
We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.
We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.
We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.
It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.
It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

| | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;_tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

| | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;_tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. # September 22, 2024
---
|
# Has the Government Gone Too Far?
---
|
---
| Having faced many challenges growing up as the child of migrant workers, my heart has always gone out to the troubled youth I identified with. In 2014, hoping to make an impact on the lives of these youth, I ran and was elected to the Hollister School Board.
At one of my first school board meetings, we were asked to approve routine agenda items including changing the word PUPIL to STUDENT in all of the district's governing documents to "align with the state of California". This was a slight-of-hand effort by the government to strip parents of their rights. The definition of PUPIL is a person under a guardian (i.e. parent). The definition of STUDENT is one who attends classes at school (i.e. no parent permission required).
Erin Friday, a local attorney and parental rights advocate, found how devastating this little terminology change played out when she was summoned to her daughter's school. Her child had an important announcement. Backed up and encouraged by the school counselors, Erin's daughter announced that "she" was now a "he" and this was "his" new name. Erin was devastated but was warned that if she tried to transition her child back, the child would commit suicide.
When they come after our children, the government has gone too far.
Because of Erin's experience, and that of countless other parents, I boldly stand for parental rights. My billboards say, "When they come after our children, the government has gone too far." This wording might seem too strong, but when schools secretly transition children and hide that from parents... they have gone too far.
As a Democrat, Erin first tried to reach out to Democrat legislators to get safeguards in place for children. She was totally rebuffed. It was Republican legislators including State Senator Shannon Grove and Assemblyman Bill Essayli who have tried to help.
Today Erin is part of Our Duty, a worldwide organization fighting on behalf of parents and children. You can read and join her Substack here: [https://tinyurl.com/OurDutySubstack](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R_kwnLfHD9nDlGMT570j5Q9IJNtTY7OEdnzmE3e2i8-59U1V4WvPejorfmhQ7gY-HMtbG6-NGgrV23vFH6d6T2DpXUsUkGvGzfe5kS5gagMOnZUGxqeaV18XUdh6qv_BTEPgcv0DeyK5GEdN40k_9lfdy_Zmrk_wNxTuRBmlhnob05cGF3J0JJKJHhAfGsRJ6fli_GEaEnl9dPesc7tywbUbF-83KnWG5mHRk-SfFoh8d6Qq1e2mq0TCJOC-D70FwTd8qNddDxmT2r-xvPtkQjIQjt_ZXR5tXmZlEzWr9S8=&c=CiC4aKhrqUT7VhkXivAv1l5JBPR6qbaUPXcITa2sW3oe44rW5Jo0DQ==&ch=8b5ZkIinu_V1izgD9mYWuDjFJjlNnyQbOGfnmM8Fql6zbdj8tOwNcQ==).
Although still registered as a Democrat, Erin Friday has endorsed me for Congress and is making clear that Democrats need to support Republican candidates to bring an end to this gender turmoil with our kids.
---
---
| "I support Peter Hernandez. He is pro-family and supports transparency in schools. His adversary, Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren, has been in office since 1995. She pretends to care about "our daughters & granddaughters," yet she is an advocate for males who believe that they are women and can enter and participate as females in sports and gain entrance into female-only spaces, and calling Gail Heriot of the US Commission on Civil Rights a "bigot" for believing in biologic reality." Erin Friday, Esq.
---
| I am proud that activist Democrats like Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh, who ran against Zoe Lofgren in the March Primary, and Erin Friday, attorney and parental rights advocate, have both endorsed me for Congress.
---

I need to put up more billboards with this message which resonates with parents regardless of party affiliation. Can you please donate and help me get the message out.
We must stand up for children and parental rights, and my opponent will never support that! Thank you for your support.

| | Dear Fellow American,

Are you enjoying your _Imprimis_ subscription?

Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most interesting conservatives each month?

I hope so.

You will never have to pay for _Imprimis_ because we want its message in defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many citizens as possible.

We're grateful that you read _Imprimis_ , and we hope you share your copy with others after you've read it--and that you encourage others you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale relies on a nationwide network of supporters--people like you--to help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and strong national defense.

You're a longtime _Imprimis_ subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our country.

And you understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate the American people about our founding principles of liberty...the importance of reviving limited constitutional government...the need to defend the rule of law...and the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free enterprise.

**[That's why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale College.](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkb9u3DAMxp9G3mzQlOyrBg1BHU9JWrRDgS6GzqJ9QiVZ0J8WefvCxV33jORHfuSP_PG6vGrrbNjftCe1ubSkvAS93Kxzrau_KLTWx2R9zQsCihZki7j0jVHQSyNEQ6q_4AUAZN83NzXq7ZMEIbgeyVw32gBwgOE6CKkNB2qsOn1AIoIUo8CulwOIQY8k5HXrR2ICtKNUui0RmcPrYJy9UirvieKRSrcevnHqVkrMjD8xnBnOmdaayHTn3tloRx2ZynD-H581NZ79dyCb23IY_c74nFfGJ-gF4BugwJfPP6cv0_Pzd4ZjLX7JR00rMT7FdORIa7Fhv0uejK2e8Ym8tu6eXLWP2u6B8ekx6qEcoVAojE9fn9r55Vv7OEWTlIl_rHM2jxcmYD_t_oGWjzzlt8K_AQAA___uWpes) **

Other colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural relativism and the oppression of "political correctness"--Hillsdale has not--and it continues to fulfill its mission of defending civil and religious liberty through education.

**Will you help?**

In addition to sending _Imprimis_ to more Americans, you will help us...

* Teach Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American Heritage, the Great Books, and more through **free online courses (to date, more than _4 million students_ have registered for one or more courses)**;

* Launch and support dozens more **classical K-12 schools** nationwide--schools where students receive an education rooted in the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands more are on waiting lists.

Your support is especially needed today because **Hillsdale College does not accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. We refuse to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Whatever amount you give today, whether it's...

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc52bac45e0d4266b137f1040ca8ef30&_e=8RdZ_5yacxGcSbcVeLFpllHtefCcQ58RGo9IBT2-CVtNUsqKP6vf1pVROsGC6ZD10DjPUNb8s7cGlSqbcEWtO-_4vS05775Pck58RyFQ5IMkM1yrDCeYUBkpPA7WFzaGcTkjV1E3DkzovJ1aEnkud2lDXZhyyHb3PgG7JYmqPTXh3zjPl6jR6ualR_VrgxWIQ_OD03iIoBbs_YPzCg-MS41hi-C_cTpFnnCsTdNSpp1e0__h8BU1QxYEyzkPuLrAG79BwBEaTZQ5KiK_7L2k-yH6XekeW71KhIZS6ey1au3001FoQSKJ7aNXvVBC2RHTijLOs411RiT1YzDySyg9vDty8spY7b_3-wvZjyE21ZiEyIRlC_l6P-AnpTs4zsdn)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cc52bac45e0d4266b137f1040ca8ef30&_e=8RdZ_5yacxGcSbcVeLFpllHtefCcQ58RGo9IBT2-CVtNUsqKP6vf1pVROsGC6ZD10DjPUNb8s7cGlSqbcEWtO-_4vS05775Pck58RyFQ5IMkM1yrDCeYUBkpPA7WFzaGcTkjV1E3DkzovJ1aEnkud2lDXZhyyHb3PgG7JYmqPTXh3zjPl6jR6ualR_VrgxWIQ_OD03iIoBbs_YPzCg-MS41hi-C_cTpFnnCsTdNSpp3DMBdJK6P69bWy9M-MLu9YGXLH5ssmbOKK6HD_g1cj-qA_4-M56s47I1PZleMUulbllUTd8jk3caCMyOoc-Gsw1VG7PF702jLDN8P-IdZ1VG3lpFsP-yoWxwm_l3-qJeFohfRv5qmq3ysWCOK8PJTw)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

| | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-YAN&utm;_tc=YAN-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

## Hezbollah Reeling from Strikes in Lebanon
Iranian officials said Saturday that the Middle East was on the brink of war as [Israel shifts its focus](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2YyOw8Tx4KELW7p2RAc-B1cGI9sJbX99lc7dPumTnp7ex226UYhhv7_Txrb6NNFSw5MnIxElqkk1znpm5L5h22nU0PVG62a1AHo2g9cXAj8r7MEtMw5mgEWxvl6XJlgEVGAQO4ArYEudHoxDcG7oDXkvFLALNeX2M4W9ruzjd3pybpe0NdGutR5F9G8CR4HjeZ4tfYVUXq_A8cUWOIJ57U7g-CgylEwcZeSZ9rTLlX_mFCOt8qQsj8ylPDJLF46YNqphkY4pNtm64wwxhnLRQsF9oxD_FOr_QZ4WfwMAAP__KsdikA) from Hamas to Iranian-backed Hezbollah. Israel confirmed a targeted strike in Beirut, Lebanon, on Friday that killed Ibrahim Aqil, a senior Hezbollah commander believed to be responsible for the 1983 bombing of a U.S. Marines barracks. Ahmed Wahbi, commander of Hezbollah's central training unit, was also killed in the [strike that saw 37 deaths total](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAUheGnwQ4HLyBrQZHGbtOmdBCu682i7ADRSZ4-Y-p0Z-Zrzvwf9-nuKNL-eHcb2rqkyflKB04DB-CgJtUEuyACygZtZ8CITg7GNKuVsu9vXmrojTKoFqWFFtK4IFzvNfQNWRCgxADQCXET0LrO6CGACEHLwS0LUwID1ZTbz0R7XXGJ3-nA3Pq0NdGutb4Kk28MRgbjeZ7tPvsdz3I5g_GaF6QcA4NxxZ85xehW7tO2uT1gLvxJMWLgVLLDyEvN9EQ-I-WvygMe5JHP0ZVaePa76wyIm26yDa-TYqTSG6bEY3MU_z7V_wsdFn4DAAD__4X8acg). The risk of [all-out war between Israel and Hezbollah](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L-SozAMgPGnMZ0yRvwxFC6uocu1VzIC5KCLgjNGl5vs0-_s1lt_zTe_P9f5SqJy3H7Tg6OlPNNq8uJ5BETAdm6rLSZm5KbiWAcMvm7GEKo9YtcnCiNiv3RrWoi3PpGnpl7S0LQLVxLRY-tHxNr7weOF6tCNG_pt65qRUnKt500sl8vfLIftnPSdX1wua35UGnez5-maXw4nh5PtvIvqV3M4PbPK-nY4yWFcDjLJB6nDqR1G7HGAnT-WrEo7JCl8Qsnrne0EOSyDnIVYgZJxgYWl_DMgM1rvYFkVipx8gmVogsOpKnF7_hdVOfvgWn97kHx_VPaz2CviZwAAAP__q5BwRA) continues to rise after 11 months of the two sides exchanging fire but stopping short of all-out war.
## Musk Agrees to Brazil's Demands
Elon Musk's X is [agreeing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAUhH8NbFiPBwlhYOjiLV07WgSebSocLEzstr--cucupxtO90nfx324-5TTc3r3C7k2lsGHlnYarEAUqAfNoxuJkBQnJw0akMoaw2enrLfkA4K9aQDllQwK9YOuUkkgG3hyCKjBIkqAG2DnpbnYiBDjRVk_jkwDxdRK7T5LeraZxvxddqpdKAvPbm5t3Zh6Y9gz7I_j6NpMO9WJzgHD_rxn2NuzyjM0XuBqDcP-S4SyrDnRJh7V_6QsttdaaSERyqs2Xl1cj5Rz2q6GaZgWn_Iftv0vYXf4GwAA___Dc1wT) to the demands of Brazil's Supreme Court in order to restore access to the social media platform in the country. On Saturday, Brazil's highest court ordered X to [name legal representation in the country within five days](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQxvGnwW4dXPE4Coo0dpc2pbPqomRQboCcMU-fMXXqr_l9_4_H8CAf_L6808a2uDjQVPyLBwOIgGpQ1WwdM3JbsW00atm0RutqtcjKIN5Ne-eO3NgwoRrH200TdpNDV3mLEpU0iI2Ud4k1NbozM8p57lpDzgklefYlpvoz-r2s7MIZX5zqKW5VsGspzyzaN4G9wP44jjrxV-GUr11gX3ha9xjicgrsv2GnjTOMiX58gMALBUj8TJx5L3R9Al8yBDpOThkynXDxQBrARmBfJTs_Dx-CzzctlFw28uFPUv7v8rL4GwAA__9DUWYr), a demand X was already in the process of complying with based on a statement from the firm's lawyers on Friday. X's attorneys also agreed to [pay fines](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3rDw2QlhYOjiLV07Woc54mswRIbaTX99lc5dvuWTnp7ex3W6IkdOt3dcydaQJ5wr7zQZCSBhmIbG20AE1DdkOw1adb3RulmsNuCD0bND3TsipzyRp7PzzgzGmUvDFhQMygB0Sl0UtNjpk_GgvD_1BkMQgyLPNW_tZ-ZUFwrxmXfa2jmvTbRLrY8i-jcBo4DxOI52Tm5-nQLGF1rAqIyAsXsNxZzk-lXuRX5LTF6WilvkdJcBZ5IeOT5l4ERFcpJuwx-OMuRNOkySdiycU7vUNTab9Y-DY-Ry1mJQtxU5_inV_wPtFn4DAAD__7jBaSk) and to take down accounts that a Brazilian justice deemed a threat to Brazil's democracy, reversing Musk's vocal stance to defend free speech in the country.

body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8d1aa6d236c5419a948c312fe645399f&_e=6PtQaD6PAwbAQ4IG4gyhfF2txUzcnhQS-OqOeOYgM8RHz6DoffMihlxa5xH5arPSqgND4fkp_Eq-BOzXgbHsUkWnwLmvr4uao3VAwIbvbrVyh4C-tsmBVzMT0fThpmN8cs-yOqxZykHa1z11k1wylDA1aY2-68rKM1TKtidQluhIDSEVVDMBiFc3L3Z0v3xW4CEg_qHY8KPsTS-mtfuAajEVagpFYH3348jV9NBkZYKVj7AT8LWK_Nx7C1lP2W52LgbZqf3ANT30HRWQMeWjoCHW7U2lo_ePUvbVtIEVSyF63GYfaVSRR0M_Ej6-lvblzB0hfqiguTSKFdNOu0zDaU0VT2mF02lhtD8_U7FFs5Ls8Qg2KBNJRffvd1lWkJe1)

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8d1aa6d236c5419a948c312fe645399f&_e=6PtQaD6PAwbAQ4IG4gyhfF2txUzcnhQS-OqOeOYgM8RHz6DoffMihlxa5xH5arPSqgND4fkp_Eq-BOzXgbHsUkWnwLmvr4uao3VAwIbvbrVyh4C-tsmBVzMT0fThpmN8cs-yOqxZykHa1z11k1wylDA1aY2-68rKM1TKtidQluhIDSEVVDMBiFc3L3Z0v3xW4CEg_qHY8KPsTS-mtfuAajEVagpFYH3348jV9NBkZYK9VMAYvHPRxsoVrx1XuVYsLZ0sh4BhwER9TGlulIznVk5bD_MzcRlYY81HVYNfDUW7ARNdWbmdpYHpT6JEd49Y2Brv76yana8BJXoAS20wVRGaGk0EtptqNxodn3SDtAsTFu6PXEe-IyYmarH-ahF0)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8d1aa6d236c5419a948c312fe645399f&_e=6PtQaD6PAwbAQ4IG4gyhfF2txUzcnhQS-OqOeOYgM8RHz6DoffMihlxa5xH5arPSqgND4fkp_Eq-BOzXgbHsUkWnwLmvr4uao3VAwIbvbrVyh4C-tsmBVzMT0fThpmN8cs-yOqxZykHa1z11k1wylDA1aY2-68rKM1TKtidQluhIDSEVVDMBiFc3L3Z0v3xW4CEg_qHY8KPsTS-mtfuAajEVagpFYH3348jV9NBkZYKJo71l6CMR3Zgpe2zViGJJ-BX-NEY5eqinTZEdtlpkooIMoLFXaCjKgy1vhznicLjfYf7x-MNw7Ok2MV7OqGlEsc0kxH2Jj0mIyS_inPUVc-S4qIP_MZuXfUReLwIH5gwcezAPgt5mQwnHw76MHIfj)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

subject: Can we count on your support?
body:
Are you enjoying your Imprimis subscription?

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/e4udgtucQuNMrgqxJD1-hQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0pBSP0SvaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtaW1wcmltaXMtdG9kYXk_c2M9MDE0MDJOMDI0MkxDWkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWltcHJpbWlzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDkyMlcDc3BjQgpm68z172Yg0SrUUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

Are you enjoying your _Imprimis_ subscription?

Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most interesting conservatives each month?

I hope so.

You will never have to pay for _Imprimis_ because we want its message in defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many citizens as possible.

We're grateful that you read _Imprimis_ , and we hope you share your copy with others after you've read it--and that you encourage others you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale relies on a nationwide network of supporters--people like you--to help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and strong national defense.

You're a longtime _Imprimis_ subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our country.

And you understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate the American people about our founding principles of liberty...the importance of reviving limited constitutional government...the need to defend the rule of law...and the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free enterprise.

**[That's why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale College.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/e4udgtucQuNMrgqxJD1-hQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0pBSP0SvaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtaW1wcmltaXMtdG9kYXk_c2M9MDE0MDJOMDI0MkxDWkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWltcHJpbWlzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDkyMlcDc3BjQgpm68z172Yg0SrUUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) **

| People like the neighbors and church friends that helped Lucas’ family get by when his parents were bankrupted by medical bills. People like the Scout master, track coach, and public school teachers who mentored and supported Lucas growing up. People like the veterans at Lucas’ local Marine Corps league in mid-Missouri, who taught him that he could honor and protect everyone who took care of him by serving like they did. Lucas and I both learned that family values are really about people taking care of each other and doing the right thing. Through good times, and tough times. All that other noise from the politicians... [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T66da4ecb-6f33-4d6e-8b4f-fadf0749bed6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) That’s something else. In Missouri this November, there’s a real choice in the Senate race. Josh Hawley only won his last race with 51% of the vote — and that was before he helped overturn Roe, enacted a total abortion ban, voted against IVF and birth control, stalled healthcare for veterans, and cost taxpayers $250,000 by breaking transparency laws to help his own campaign. Lucas Kunce is the Marine veteran who can beat him. It won’t be easy, but it will be worth it. So I’m asking: [Will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race and Blue Amp Action by splitting a donation of any amount today? Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

Learning
about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced
persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes
enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are
especially important today, as Christians face increasing
opposition from the culture.

But,
beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early
Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to
proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the
foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history,
can make understanding the most important historical points
difficult.

To
uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online
course, "Ancient Christianity," now available on DVD.

In this
course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first
four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways
the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you
help support this course so we can make it available to millions
of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your
support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for
any donations of $100 or more.

You can
watch the video trailer for the course and get your copy of
"Ancient Christianity" on DVD using the secure link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63569593:s8W9iWWNN:m:3:2532013465:6B90F69D12160003CE46673956EC0627:r

Thank you
for your support in reaching millions of Americans with the story
of the courage and faith of the first Christians.

Best
regards,

Jeremiah
Regan, Ph.D.
Executive
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

My community’s jobs were sent overseas, and what replaced them was addiction and despair.

I grew up with nothing in my Mamaw’s small house.

Peter, As someone who is interested in protecting democracy, you know that state legislatures can be _key_ to enacting new redistricting reforms, strengthening existing redistricting reforms, and providing a key check on Republican attempts to gerrymander. As part of our 2024 electoral strategy, we’ve identified states where we need to _flip or hold_ key chambers to help protect free and fair elections. **So many of these state-level races come down to just _hundreds_ of votes. **It means the work we do to reach and educate voters about the stakes of these races _really_ matters. [**Can you make a donation today to help safeguard democracy?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93318419/500094279/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambersNOR_email_20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_campaign=StateChambersNOR&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwMmQ2ZjQ1LWRlNzgtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=thx52eRWUywsLFioM0K7MxNZUXTusVQHDF1NSEN_7rM=) Let’s quickly review the strategy: **FOUR TO FLIP** | In four of our priority states, the Republican Party controls _both_ chambers of the state legislatures. With this kind of power, Trump’s MAGA allies have the opportunity to bring Project 2025 policies into our communities. [**Push back and flip seats →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93318420/500094280/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambersNOR_email_20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_campaign=StateChambersNOR&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwMmQ2ZjQ1LWRlNzgtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=thx52eRWUywsLFioM0K7MxNZUXTusVQHDF1NSEN_7rM=)
---
**New Hampshire:** Republicans have to defend _tiny_ majorities — _the House is considered a toss-up_ and the Senate is within reach. The Republican trifecta could redraw its congressional map at any moment, so a flip here is critical to put GOP gerrymandering to rest.
**Georgia:** Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. The _twenty-seven_ state legislature candidates we’ve endorsed as Democracy Defenders give us a real chance to gain real ground, lay the groundwork for more victories to come, and push back against GOP attacks on our democracy.
**Wisconsin:** Earlier this year, the Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court and now we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly and making gains in the State Senate — our best shot in a generation.
**Arizona:** Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the State House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can build power that can be used to strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
**TWO TO HOLD**
In two of our priority states, Democrats hold a trifecta of their state government, which means Republicans are doing everything they can to regain seats and undo progress. [**Hold the line and protect democracy →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93318421/500094281/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambersNOR_email_20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_campaign=StateChambersNOR&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwMmQ2ZjQ1LWRlNzgtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=thx52eRWUywsLFioM0K7MxNZUXTusVQHDF1NSEN_7rM=)
---
**Michigan:** Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
**Minnesota:** Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, *only* the full State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back.
**ONE SPECIAL COMMONWEALTH**
And in one Commonwealth, we need to do both. [**Double down for fair maps →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93318422/500094282/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambersNOR_email_20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240922-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambersNOR_&utm_campaign=StateChambersNOR&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwMmQ2ZjQ1LWRlNzgtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=thx52eRWUywsLFioM0K7MxNZUXTusVQHDF1NSEN_7rM=)
---
**Pennsylvania:** Here, Republicans control the State Senate and Democrats control the House. If we flip the Senate _and_ hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform.
***
Our state-by-state strategy relies on people like you who believe in safeguarding democracy. clean_body: We need to flip or hold these key chambers in November. | Peter, As someone who is interested in protecting democracy, you know that state legislatures can be key to enacting new redistricting reforms, strengthening existing redistricting reforms, and providing a key check on Republican attempts to gerrymander. As part of our 2024 electoral strategy, we’ve identified states where we need to flip or hold key chambers to help protect free and fair elections. So many of these state-level races come down to just hundreds of votes. It means the work we do to reach and educate voters about the stakes of these races really matters. = Let’s quickly review the strategy: FOUR TO FLIP | In four of our priority states, the Republican Party controls both chambers of the state legislatures. With this kind of power, Trump’s MAGA allies have the opportunity to bring Project 2025 policies into our communities. = New Hampshire: Republicans have to defend tiny majorities — the House is considered a toss-up and the Senate is within reach. The Republican trifecta could redraw its congressional map at any moment, so a flip here is critical to put GOP gerrymandering to rest. Georgia: Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. The twenty-seven state legislature candidates we’ve endorsed as Democracy Defenders give us a real chance to gain real ground, lay the groundwork for more victories to come, and push back against GOP attacks on our democracy. Wisconsin: Earlier this year, the Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court and now we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly and making gains in the State Senate — our best shot in a generation. Arizona: Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the State House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can build power that can be used to strengthen the state’s redistricting process. TWO TO HOLD In two of our priority states, Democrats hold a trifecta of their state government, which means Republicans are doing everything they can to regain seats and undo progress. = Michigan: Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. Minnesota: Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, only the full State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back. ONE SPECIAL COMMONWEALTH And in one Commonwealth, we need to do both. = Pennsylvania: Here, Republicans control the State Senate and Democrats control the House. If we flip the Senate and hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. * Our state-by-state strategy relies on people like you who believe in safeguarding democracy. With under 50 days until the election, there’s never been a more impactful time to help create fair maps in these priority states. = Thank you, NDRC HQ = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. | | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

A message from _Broad + Liberty_ CEO Terry Tracy:

On Constitution Day 2019, we launched _Broad + Liberty_ because we saw a need in our region and state for a different voice — an independent voice — in political news and analysis. Since then, we have grown and had an impact on the conversation in ways we never suspected would be possible half a decade ago in a challenging media environment.

And the growth continues. From breaking national news — as in Todd Shepherd’s [award-winning](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=83de84bb51&e=b7b3eddce2) coverage of the [CTCL “Zuckerbucks” scandal](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b2b34b5e90&e=b7b3eddce2) — to uncovering [scandals closer to home](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4a7c6f7e27&e=b7b3eddce2) that no other news organization would touch (until we did), _Broad + Liberty_ has worked to function as a check on an otherwise one-sided media establishment.

Thanks to steadfast readers like you - as well as the many generous donors, dedicated board members, talented writers and intrepid reporters, committed strategic partners, and so many others - we consistently have a direct impact on policy outcomes; we are recognized nationally for our non-partisan investigative journalism; and we give voice to those ideas and perspectives that have been shut out of our civil discourse for too long.

In an era desperately in need of honest voices and fact-based conversation, we will continue to do our part. Our credibility is our currency. You are our lifeblood. Here’s to the next five years of growth, impact, and influence. Stay broad-minded.

Happy 5th Birthday, _Broad + Liberty_.

### **1.[The Land of Opportunity versus a bumper sticker slogan](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1ce05307d4&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Andy Bloom_
Vice President Kamala Harris remains vague about her plans and limits speaking with the media because she has a difficult task talking about “turning the page” and “a new way forward” while at the same time serving as the current Vice President.

The economy is consistently the number one issue in the 2024 election, an issue that does not serve her well. Harris’s salve for the economic problems this administration created is her “opportunity economy.”
What is the “opportunity economy?” She offers few hints, and much of what she has said has been panned even by the liberal media and fellow Democrats.

America doesn’t need Kamala Harris to create an opportunity economy. For over two centuries, the United States has been known as “the land of opportunity” because of the possibilities for economic success, upward mobility, and personal freedoms.

**Why It Matters**. As lawmakers tinker with the system, trying to produce equal results instead of ensuring equal opportunities guaranteed in our founding documents, the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution, the country risks moving toward European-style socialism and further from the land of opportunity.

America has been the land of opportunity since the first colonists came from Europe. The United States became the greatest and most powerful country in the history of the world because of a combination of historical events, economic policies, and a legal framework that creates an environment where individuals have the potential to achieve personal and financial success to the best of their abilities.

### **2.[State high court warns PennDOT of overreaching on voter registration](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d073a7b10a&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Todd Shepherd_
For at least a year or more, the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation has been changing people’s voter registration information whenever someone registers a vehicle, according to a recent Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruling on election issues. In most cases, the address for voter registration information is the same as the vehicle registration, so no changes are necessary. But in that small percentage of cases in which a person might have multiple domiciles or might be moving, the change could cause havoc for some voters.

Last week the Pennsylvania Supreme Court issued a ruling on election law that made headlines because it dealt with the much debated signature requirement for mail-in ballots, a decision that could impact some races this November.

But an underreported element of the Supreme Court’s ruling also detailed how PennDOT automatically changed a Butler Township citizen’s voter registration when he registered a vehicle using an address that was his second residence in a different county, but still not his primary residence.

**Why It Matters**. In their separate opinions, Justices Mundy and Wecht expressed serious concerns about the new practices.

Although it’s hard to pinpoint exactly when PennDOT began these changes, they seem to have been joined to Governor Shapiro’s [decision one year ago](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=504d164642&e=b7b3eddce2) to implement “automatic voter registration (AVR)” for “residents obtaining driver licenses and ID cards at Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) driver and photo license centers.”

Previously, persons applying for a Pennsylvania driver’s license or ID card could “opt in” for voter registration by checking a box on the application form. But with Shapiro’s executive order, the voter now had to check an “opt out” box if they did not want to register to vote at the same time as getting a license or ID.
The same methodology appears to now apply to vehicle registration.

**Quotable**. “From my understanding, the Republicans have benefited from this, but that’s not my point. The rule of law has to stand,” state Senator Cris Dush said.

We, the Georgia House Democrats, are excited to share our key goals for this year’s crucial elections across our great state. As a coalition of dynamic leaders from every corner of Georgia, we are dedicated to ensuring that you have access to quality healthcare, a world-class education, affordable housing, and good jobs. Together, we are committed to building a brighter future for all Georgians.
This November, we must protect Democratic seats that are under attack and work to flip new seats blue. Please support our efforts to bolster these pivotal campaigns and help us make a lasting impact in our communities.
WHEN WE FIGHT, WE WIN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/may-24-em?express_lane_other=true]
Each and every day, Democrats fight for a freer and fairer Georgia, working to protect reproductive rights, pass common-sense gun safety legislation, and defend our constitutional voting rights. To continue this fight, we need to elect and reelect more Democrats to join us in the Georgia House of Representatives—leaders committed to delivering freedom, equity, and safety for all Georgians.
This fall, we’re defending nine incumbent Democrats, with two facing extreme opposition from GOP challengers pouring money into their radical agendas. At the same time, we’re working hard to flip eleven seats, three of which show strong polling for our Democratic candidates. But none of these victories are possible without your support. ### The Hillary-Biden EV Mandate

On Thursday, Hillary Scholten voted no on a bill to repeal the extreme EV mandate that would cripple the automotive industry in Michigan. She disingenuously claims this is "not an EV mandate," even though no Detroit automaker could meet the government tailpipe requirements without selling massive / unrealistic numbers of EVs.
Even worse, Scholten trashes our state's bread-and-butter industry saying this bill is "bending a knee to big polluters" --- by which she means the Michigan automakers who provide livelihoods to hundreds of thousands of people in this state! Just an out of touch and unacceptable position for a member of Congress in Michigan.

Mike Rogers is taking on Democrat Rep. Elissa Slotkin and sources inside Rogers campaign are saying “he does not have enough” money to win this race. - GOP Candidate, Army Captain, and IED-blast survivor Sam Brown is neck-and-neck in the polls with Democrat Incumbent Jacky Rosen, but Brown is staring down a 4-to-1 financial disadvantage he can't fix without our help. - West Point Graduate, Army Captain, and now GOP candidate Dave McCormick has brought this race within the margin of error in the polls, but he has been outspent by a margin of more than 3-to-1 so far. These special interest donors have already started to place six-figure ad buys against me — spreading misinformation to voters to prop up my Republican opponent. Any sign of weakness on our fundraising report could be a go-ahead indicator for them to spend more. A strong fundraising support will help show what they’re up against: a powerful grassroots movement that is sick and tired of special interests using their money to buy our elections. And your support will help ensure we can fight back against whatever they throw at us in the weeks to come. [**A donation of any amount today would be a huge help. If you’re able, can you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to publish a strong final report, fight back against these special interests trying to buy this seat for their Republican of choice, and defend our Senate majority?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2697?amount=28&t=8&akid=2352%2E4032634%2EAoja1l)
