#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)
Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.
**The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.** Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country.
I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. **Please let me explain.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)**
I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021.
He totally disgraced my home state that day... raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door.
**But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe.**
Hawley himself played a major role in overturning Roe V. Wade — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide.
Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book.
It’s just shameful.
**[CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)**
**Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce.** I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did, from online ads and emails just like this one.
I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. I also saw he was running a real campaign — outraising Hawley, earning record-breaking support, bringing people together regardless of what party they’re from or who they’ve voted for before.
And I saw it’s made the polls get closer, too.
I’m all-in to help Lucas because I know he can win this race. I know Missouri can elect a Senator we can all be proud of. And I know if we all pitch in, we can run that coward Josh Hawley out of the Senate!
**I’m about to get to the most important part of this email, but first I need to ask:[Will you please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley by donating $10 or more to his grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)
---
I want you to take what I’m about to tell you seriously, Peter.
**With so much on the line this year, Missouri’s U.S. Senate race is one of the most important in America — one of our ONLY chances to flip a GOP-held seat.**
**First off, Josh Hawley is far more vulnerable than any national news outlet will lead you to believe.** Hawley won his last election with only 51% of the vote, with a margin weaker than Trump’s by double digits. Since then, polls consistently show he’s the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this cycle, with approval ratings even lower than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida.
Maybe even more telling than all that... after January 6th, Hawley’s former mentor, three-term Missouri Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth said supporting Hawley’s campaign in 2018 was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
Hawley’s base abandoned him. And he hasn’t won them back.
**[CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)**
**Meanwhile, Lucas has consistently played offense** — holding Hawley accountable for his extreme record while getting his own positive message of taking back power for working people in front of voters across Missouri.
He’s earned critical support from Missouri’s election-winning labor movement, groups like Abortion Action Missouri, Social Security Works, and End Citizens United — and even the Missouri Fire Fighters, who normally endorse Republicans. **With help from real people like you, all across the country, he’s built a record-breaking movement to flip this Senate seat.**
Frankly, Peter, Lucas Kunce and Missouri’s U.S. Senate race haven’t got the attention they deserve this year. But that’s OK, because it hasn’t changed this truth:
**Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley if he has the resources to make it happen.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)**
Time isn't on our side here. November 5th will be here before we know it, and we’ve gotta make every moment count for Lucas and the team.
We’ve gotta make sure they have the resources to fight back hard against the onslaught of attacks that have already started from Hawley and his campaign.
Oh yeah, I forgot to mention — _Hawley is so afraid of Lucas, he hasn’t even run a single ad about his own record in the Senate._ It’s all just false attack ads against Lucas!
**If you’re able to support Lucas right now in this important moment, you can make a real difference for our country this year, Peter.** So I’m personally asking:
**[Will you please join me in supporting Lucas’ campaign by donating $10, $25, or just whatever you can today? Lucas is committed to running his campaign the right way, without a single cent from corporate PACs, so anything you’re able to give really will make a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72746?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72745?refcode=em20240922-7766&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=7766%2E614464%2Erdegkw)
---
Thank you for listening,
John Goodman
Born-and-raised Missourian

name: Leaders We Deserve
subject: A year ago…
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240922&t=1&akid=1208%2E587540%2EuC-nYy)
Peter, it has been **one year** since President Biden and Vice President Harris created the first ever Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
Over the past year, the OGVP has made **_real progress_** towards realizing a future free from gun violence. The office is incredibly vital because we now have a coordinated strategy to tackle the issue. By creating this office, President Biden has put federal resources towards tackling the issue of gun violence prevention head on.
This office has helped to put the pieces together to bring different stakeholders to the table. It’s changed how the government interacts with community leaders on this issue which ultimately gets us one step closer to solving this issue once and for all.
The OGVP has been pivotal in gathering bipartisan power to pass the first gun control legislation in 30 years.
The OGVP has created response tools and strategies to help support communities when events of gun violence happen. This created a plan to coordinate federal resources to help a community get back on track after a tragedy.
The OGVP has brought attention to the lack of red-flag laws at the state level, an incredibly important tool that has been left in the toolbox until now. Since then, we’ve gone from 5 states using red flag laws to 15 states now thanks to the OGVP’s important work.

The truth is that growing up, I was terrified of storms. I love chasing after tornadoes and lightning now, but when I was younger, they terrified me. My one saving grace was my local weatherman, “TV Eric,” who explained what was happening during big storms, and helped me feel safe during them. From those first few times watching “TV Eric,” I knew tha _t I_ wanted to be “TV Eric,” so I too could help kids (and adults) during scary moments. At age 27, that dream came true when I became the Chief Meteorologist at WREX in Rockford. Beyond just weather broadcasts, I continued to pay it forward by starting _Project Tornado_ \-- an initiative that brings meteorologists into schools to help kids learn about severe weather, educating over 5,000 students annually. It’s funny to think about how “young Eric” would react to using a storm metaphor for this campaign. Over the years, my focus on storms has evolved from fear to a strange admiration. Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the morning playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93342404/500162042/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk2010-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTQyZDM0ZGQtZjY3OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZCxrQmdyhhbjWnbhVrgRwKq4Ld2gFR3u5vKZugbbYik=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to _end_ them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.[Polls show that we've got a real chance to win, but I'm counting on your help to power my grassroots campaign. Friend, bodily autonomy is a basic human right and fundamental to democracy.
I lived in a world before Roe v. Wade and celebrated the court’s decision in 1973 to make abortion accessible. That’s why I was devastated to see almost 50 years of progress rolled back in an instant when the conservative Supreme Court majority overturned Roe in 2022. Either we can make decisions about our own bodies, or we are not living in a democracy.
**We can, and must, fight back – with our voices, our votes, and our grassroots support for leaders like Sherrod Brown who are fighting to restore and protect the rights of women as well as men.[Will you join me with a donation to Sherrod’s campaign right now to make sure he can keep fighting for reproductive freedom?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93343631/500165414/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3013-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMzdjNjUzZi1mODc4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M4i7FYarFR_LyC8ljjLI-dZsFTQAr9xVYHcgiWF5WZ8=)**
Sherrod’s opponent, Bernie Moreno, is an ally of Donald Trump who actually wants to nationalize women’s bodies by supporting a national abortion ban and opposing any exceptions. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

clean_body: All she needs is support from us to keep this seat in play. | Peter, Something exciting is happening out West that I need you to know about. In the presumed safe-blue state of New Mexico, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate Nella Domenici has the Democrats on their heels. Polling has her within single digits of a 15-year career left-wing politician, with 21% of voters undecided! Nella outraised Heinrich in her first quarter, and she’s unexpectedly put New Mexico in play as a seat Republicans could flip. It’s exciting to think I could have another Republican woman from the West joining me in the Senate. But most importantly, she’ll be joining us as a new vote on critical fights to secure our borders, restore economic stability, promote domestic energy production and independence, and ensure safer communities. Nella Domenici has my full support, and she’s on the brink of taking the lead in a race Democrats never thought they would have to fight. All she needs is support from us to keep this seat in play. For America, Cynthia Lummis | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Patriot,

I want to introduce myself. **My name is Pat Harrigan, and I’m a Trump-Endorsed Green Beret running for Congress in North Carolina’s 10th district.**

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-IhDkDblrY1FTi7kscKkQlWI0wMVv6Va_auQ5L7Qh7bxjCrqpC4xUez07zcAJcpLmqLwWy-IOnebXIICao7qwt53NrzSN25-GOqG3xkovLBzuseTlePRTNJHkVodTwh02DTr9kWruSHbUTu0RxW6fXA%3D%3D)
I was born on the west coast and while growing up, split my time between San Diego and small-town Wyoming.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-DqwWFu1zsh3LjyUYCX6JRMITCPQrQdBnU5N6mW3l6x-fM7Xf8z0xV3nUS_DZugd3nKvRv-XwaS0paQWxkaAJuK-CeRIYoX3ozxuEE--NV6GHc0Vxp21PggeoUAph-mwM0kLyCLloGpIXek_JOIFdGA%3D%3D)
I always knew I wanted to serve our country. After high school, I attended West Point. After graduating with a degree in Nuclear Engineering, I was commissioned into the Infantry, completed Ranger School, and was sent to Fort Wainwright, Alaska, for my first assignment as Infantry Platoon Leader.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-gnlS8cdaLBDxE4tH2UCnc3TThoj2K3ubGNI2WIyXH15-Abj4uqdCxiQWrByKsM3QEqjVfpQS6Zzds6S_MtdGg_4bwGkjWbF5XN6jvO_JRhrhKq7Z1KDi3amMuiFAtxev0Uj1XbB6j8TMESO-zj_4eA%3D%3D)
I later deployed to Afghanistan and took over a small air-access only combat outpost in the heart of the Arghandab valley. At 23 years old and in charge of roughly 350 Americans, Afghans, and expatriates, and responsible for nearly $100 million worth of infrastructure and equipment, it was a unique and formative leadership experience that shaped me for the rest of my life and led me to where I am today.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-CT37cAosjl4p7SujVe61EsQ7gEM-6_hs4EfTpVqh9LawrqSzT05I40Efh6RSQKuWX79-Qr0CdsHPW8nOj_Yi_jv_-9aXH9HiCwbVk_1w94VMlb-EydeHpaxLOWjUG8ysXJMzl9NO9fqG8B6QHn34lw%3D%3D)
My men and I enjoyed extraordinary success and upon returning to the United States, I volunteered and was selected for the Special Forces, and moved to North Carolina to complete Special Forces training.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-t6A6DhxuG081eSoUsZpICAGxMRmHQvUzFsCky3dnP_SIjQEYg40AYzBPyjxh4_NBPOfVZ8wiyjZGicBgoiCdNJE3ZsLd2swLjeGn68g-XJGsdn1pOouzO8aW8nFtlTN3gNrFLJt56j3wlt1vO25bsg%3D%3D)
After becoming a Green Beret, I returned to Afghanistan and led my Special Forces unit through increasingly difficult and challenging circumstances that corresponded with a deteriorating situation in Afghanistan. At this time, it became clear to me that the United States had lost the political will to win, and we had a true crisis of leadership brewing in our country.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-TtFJWQmxxqy5jN5DuU75lnKKTT09XgEThcjub7hMDNwScNTBTqgez210IXZB308LNz_e61iHO2MNO7pLNxSTLYzfLhVUpm72hT4LJ5Se0AP5sHku7bdAN4JR9nYBli6d0Pi1K4lY2m5mfKJRMVP_kw%3D%3D)
While on active duty, my wife Rocky and I built a small firearms business that operated from our double-wide trailer home outside of Fayetteville. It grew out of our living room, then our garage, and then out of our warehouse that we built behind the double-wide.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-VIjkWs7-PyeeCiyI8GfjHvESyyirDEF68rRE6cVobrIOrxoawSEx4UvZ_Xgbjkb4OlFdqiISEWliHs4Tgc2Koy37BWSmlTxhd_OR-r3xglCWMqi_1fKqXj3OSxZAFC_rfycxEJP2RCTEOXRKPVaJpg%3D%3D)
When I left the Army, we had created a contract-manufacturing powerhouse, which we later grew into a manufacturing powerhouse. We purchased a 120,000 square foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and have been manufacturing American made defense products in Western North Carolina ever since.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-LcJeaDsxvzeItQ2xc_htD8iyLVhUIT-_i11AZeHJtA1KT-qHNJIYgXF0-mdK9NGQneujoDnLLtpePU40Ew-DCzrvduFnoyehK3CJD83OYhzY4w8QY_mEXkE9TuEDgCzcK_NNAozfnw-OBGo0787CxQ%3D%3D)
My amazing wife Rocky and I have been married for 13 years and have 2 beautiful daughters, Reagan (6) and McKinley (4). After the fall of Afghanistan, I couldn’t stand by and watch our country deteriorate economically, socially, morally, and spiritually at the hands of failed leadership achieving failed outcomes. THAT’S why I’m running to be your next Congressman in NC-10.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=fad95bcd656441c491e3c2c9b33d16d8&_e=p5QSVCx407kspXTrR2PSSRJCDHMfSW8qYzjromDFo16o2AwequB6i9GPGywIBOyntNUzFYWkAtxRK9pZdCFjW-8l2l0p7Ys6mWBHxEnEYd-R2-cinL96KkHLgsARSaESsYhJxlo2C_ySfydZTmnpCAqXLt4_qaiycMhdNAD96Cqe4xRrnJWnJN4ej4L-Ryt-2st_Jy44FrzJQ7kVdJnm7ec9UBLrc-bwuxiLa9coGMeSqQ_oEOGqyG7g1zvB40do8nrFTys8V2F2HeKLSkgNJobpyzSs2rBN6-5z5n1HpWgqJaVKqk5Ym1kzF_ANG1OS5kbdi07phkUwfFV5Wi7TxQ%3D%3D)
Patriot, I’d NEVER ask you to support me without telling you about who I am. There are too many politicians in Washington who don’t value freedom, faith, or family, and as someone who dedicated his life to serving this country, raising a family, and running a Made In America small business, I want to serve YOU in Washington D.C.

clean_body: | Patriot, I want to introduce myself. My name is Pat Harrigan, and I’m a Trump-Endorsed Green Beret running for Congress in North Carolina’s 10th district. I was born on the west coast and while growing up, split my time between San Diego and small-town Wyoming. I always knew I wanted to serve our country. After high school, I attended West Point. After graduating with a degree in Nuclear Engineering, I was commissioned into the Infantry, completed Ranger School, and was sent to Fort Wainwright, Alaska, for my first assignment as Infantry Platoon Leader. I later deployed to Afghanistan and took over a small air-access only combat outpost in the heart of the Arghandab valley. At 23 years old and in charge of roughly 350 Americans, Afghans, and expatriates, and responsible for nearly $100 million worth of infrastructure and equipment, it was a unique and formative leadership experience that shaped me for the rest of my life and led me to where I am today. My men and I enjoyed extraordinary success and upon returning to the United States, I volunteered and was selected for the Special Forces, and moved to North Carolina to complete Special Forces training. After becoming a Green Beret, I returned to Afghanistan and led my Special Forces unit through increasingly difficult and challenging circumstances that corresponded with a deteriorating situation in Afghanistan. At this time, it became clear to me that the United States had lost the political will to win, and we had a true crisis of leadership brewing in our country. While on active duty, my wife Rocky and I built a small firearms business that operated from our double-wide trailer home outside of Fayetteville. It grew out of our living room, then our garage, and then out of our warehouse that we built behind the double-wide. When I left the Army, we had created a contract-manufacturing powerhouse, which we later grew into a manufacturing powerhouse. We purchased a 120,000 square foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and have been manufacturing American made defense products in Western North Carolina ever since. My amazing wife Rocky and I have been married for 13 years and have 2 beautiful daughters, Reagan (6) and McKinley (4). After the fall of Afghanistan, I couldn’t stand by and watch our country deteriorate economically, socially, morally, and spiritually at the hands of failed leadership achieving failed outcomes. THAT’S why I’m running to be your next Congressman in NC-10. Patriot, I’d NEVER ask you to support me without telling you about who I am. There are too many politicians in Washington who don’t value freedom, faith, or family, and as someone who dedicated his life to serving this country, raising a family, and running a Made In America small business, I want to serve YOU in Washington D.C. We have less than two months until election day, and I need all the help I can get to compete with the deep-pocketed liberals running Washington. But that’s what we’re about to ask you to do. [**Ask you to give $5.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24.0zv8Fz&refcode=em240922-1-30&t=1&akid=30035%2E3013755%2EBhmUsk)** Because right now, we’re not sure we’ve got enough in the tank to drive this home and win in November.

I created the Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to stand up to this kind of hate. | | |

Friend, On the state and federal levels, my home state of Michigan holds the keys to a future of economic, racial, and environmental justice. **But only if we fight for it.** We must defeat Donald Trump, win back the U.S. House of Representatives, and maintain Democrats’ narrow control of the U.S. Senate. **Republicans’ racist attacks on immigrants and communities of color have no place in American politics or the halls of Congress.** In a Senate hearing last week about the rise of hate crimes in the United States,**** Senator John Kennedy attacked the Muslim Executive Director of the Arab American Institute with Islamophobic and anti-Arab rhetoric. Trump and his Vice Presidential pick, Senator JD Vance, have spread hateful lies about Haitian immigrants that have resulted in violent assaults and multiple bomb threats in an Ohio community, threatening all immigrants and all Black people in our country. **And just last week, I had to stand up on the House floor, speaking out against the continued erasure of the Palestinian people** by opposing a bill that would erase Palestine from products made by Palestinians on Palestinian farms. **I created the Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to stand up to hate and to elect anti-war working-class candidates.** We’re supporting candidates who are not afraid to speak truth to power, demand human rights for all, and stand up to the billionaire bullies who pollute our politics with their attacks on our democracy and on marginalized communities. The most famous mouthpiece of the left, MSNBC, is finally waking up to the real possibility that I will be the one who could end their iron grip on the Senate majority and the disastrous Kamala Harris-Jon Tester liberal agenda

In 2006, the then-Republican incumbent thought he was on course for reelection, but **Jon Tester surprised the entire nation and beat him by just 3,562 votes. **

If we lose this race by a similar margin, I’ll never be able to forgive myself. That’s why we’re giving this race 130% daily for the next seven weeks.

A lot has happened over the last couple weeks, and our Maryland Senate race has become a focal point in the most important election cycle of our lifetimes.
**_FIRST:_** Two new polls showed me TIED with Republican Larry Hogan in the race that will ultimately decide who controls the Senate after Election Day.

# Subscription expiring with Mesoscsle with Rebekah Jones
### And a brief summary on how depositions went in Florida
| | Sep 22
---|---
I'm not supposed to go into too much detail on how depositions went in Florida last week, but what I got approval to say is this:
Depositions are the worst day of your lawsuit because they can only hurt your case. It's the defendants only chance to interrogate you without the ability to object over relevance, so your entire life is fair game.
The state tried to play dirty, weaving in questions about my college sex life, being sexually assaulted, and even my children's paternity between questions about my education, experience and the events of April/May 2020.
Their attempts to upset and provoke me failed so badly that the state ended depositions early and gave up.
The years of brutality I've been subjected to, especially online, inoculated me to the rumors, lies and conspiracy theories presented by the state.
Things went well for me, which is saying a lot.

It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last.

I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on _Roe v. Wade_. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable.

The crisp air and golden leaves represent a transition—a time to reflect on where we’ve been and where we want to go. Hi, it's Sherrod Brown. I know I say this a lot, but it's important:
Our race is the key to defending our Democratic majority in the Senate.
In a minute, I'm going to ask you to donate to help us keep the Senate blue, but click here if you want to chip in five bucks right now to split between my campaign and Tim Kaine. I'm grateful for whatever you can spare. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-sherrod]

I honestly wish money wasn't such a huge factor in this campaign, but MAGA Republicans and their billionaire megadonors are spending more money to defeat me in Ohio than in any other Senate race in the country.
We can't afford to be outspent and drowned out, folks. That's why I'm reaching out to this grassroots team for help. We rely on the supporters who read these emails to each chip in – because, collectively, we can make a BIG difference.
I'm counting on you. We're short of where we need to be to stay on track to meet our urgent midnight goal. Will you give $5 – or our average grassroots donation of $26 – to split between my campaign and Tim Kaine to help us keep the Senate blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-sherrod]

subject: Can you think of a $44 billion joke?
body:
But, in all seriousness – free speech is no joke| | | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f1fd2311ea424763b21d84a95b836ce6&_e=ENJXXI68HwFs1b15AhZFCch-krr6DZ57x_-zKK54KFfpPkyT--1EdpRiZZHsxQgje_sGljSgz6HNQR6m0LsCFEGDP1LqTfBQ4E5C23nmzc7R-qtd5n7Q2MUPzn8wySKgyxaVF9YZGlRnHXz7KRjqkQ55cmwjLCvEti_kghoncGU6jTP47GwgMBxGM5FmLJ9lej0EpIbT3IyCJP8hmYJxgwqbFkAgmUJ_1NIXk0r1L0sutOBWjj3Lo8NLJlvJ41ciG9sP_Xjk1X5njK2-kOcuKQ%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f1fd2311ea424763b21d84a95b836ce6&_e=ENJXXI68HwFs1b15AhZFCch-krr6DZ57x_-zKK54KFfpPkyT--1EdpRiZZHsxQgje_sGljSgz6HNQR6m0LsCFEGDP1LqTfBQ4E5C23nmzc7R-qtd5n7Q2MUPzn8wySKgAU9kdHCjqDsMx0rIgSyDRcqm-2SB0FM6QbwjgocQqBLsBuxQ11CI1dzysUQoVtR8VM93Bxyajwouukjo2G38E2_uRVYQMSWpPcOA80mudWZX0FFWXGPObpuS37GJ8y0glGMlfyw1_rvYHHHTcYc-DA%3D%3D)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f1fd2311ea424763b21d84a95b836ce6&_e=ENJXXI68HwFs1b15AhZFCch-krr6DZ57x_-zKK54KFfpPkyT--1EdpRiZZHsxQgje_sGljSgz6HNQR6m0LsCFEGDP1LqTfBQ4E5C23nmzc7R-qtd5n7Q2MUPzn8wySKgVDCUvbiENRfBkLEKUKa8PuniIDhiYYgpkrmo0p8Zq9s-YPS7bCwCPfNZsgaJrFxIqBgNbNaBeFUJyzTasNnefhrPVE9hbc41vlgb7b-9c3jXdnRv_NLKkwad2FAC1bpu_97Z2_sXaSfVEb8kb2UP-Q%3D%3D)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f1fd2311ea424763b21d84a95b836ce6&_e=ENJXXI68HwFs1b15AhZFCch-krr6DZ57x_-zKK54KFfpPkyT--1EdpRiZZHsxQgje_sGljSgz6HNQR6m0LsCFEGDP1LqTfBQ4E5C23nmzc7R-qtd5n7Q2MUPzn8wySKgYhk75sUo6ul03OKeiQtdzOu0GzzlwAluQ4NYIf67F23gHjfp4xFUakK02e2tyZysrgkhNUWQBkG-1Xg5s0rhu5074q_Lduy3UOvHLwT0zTvpTLYzqeNbwcEHFfKKIyYj1pWzBP3UFw30k9lP2c2zCg%3D%3D)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f1fd2311ea424763b21d84a95b836ce6&_e=ENJXXI68HwFs1b15AhZFCch-krr6DZ57x_-zKK54KFfpPkyT--1EdpRiZZHsxQgje_sGljSgz6HNQR6m0LsCFEGDP1LqTfBQ4E5C23nmzc7R-qtd5n7Q2MUPzn8wySKgZDyE_hN7UQJDdVH_oqoglXYOL-3a8WXIpHhLp-kfeEonK0fXFhY1MEWw9Rj-HvNQ9joerVcjx7ju5j7bygSC6gtB0Y9tQvHZR2SB3pIN4t7RKuscXjtGAKymvoV8w7-lJEL8t8ATq4SGj15vugQG6g%3D%3D)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f1fd2311ea424763b21d84a95b836ce6&_e=ENJXXI68HwFs1b15AhZFCch-krr6DZ57x_-zKK54KFfpPkyT--1EdpRiZZHsxQgje_sGljSgz6HNQR6m0LsCFEGDP1LqTfBQ4E5C23nmzc7R-qtd5n7Q2MUPzn8wySKg6wocOOSob7OFhE9MkW5OVohBfYUe7iXmo32yJCbaB8qrBU9EMNTKyDiq7Tt8Gh4DWWjIBUcqElucBEEHnpEKK8otQQayX-rwyoYi5KUdt-fHT_JW60J7thgCpCmhVYQvsaCetXHvduGpmcM27l1z1A%3D%3D)** Thanks for considering standing with us. We'll stand with you, too.

| Peter,

In case you missed it, Trump’s campaign is going after me for calling attention to his plan to fire federal workers – a direct threat to Virginia’s economy, Virginia’s federal employees, and thousands of Virginia jobs.

Under “Agenda 47” on his campaign website, he’s promising to bring back the reckless Schedule F executive order on “Day One.” He plans on firing public servants, those who have dedicated their lives to service — and then replacing them with Trump loyalists.

Virginia has more than 140,000 federal workers. Trump’s agenda would put the livelihoods of thousands of Virginians at risk.

The Virginians who have dedicated their careers to serving our country — including scientists, civilian DoD employees, law enforcement officers, infectious disease researchers, attorneys, and accountants — do not deserve this level of contempt.

After I called attention to this terrible idea, Trump’s campaign attacked me and tried to backpedal Agenda 47’s disastrous impacts on Virginia’s economy. Don’t be fooled – Virginians know what’s at stake this November.

| | Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don't know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of life's most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **" The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King"** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David's character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.

These 104 Democracy Defenders are **_critical_** to safeguarding and strengthening democracy:
**In Georgia** , we're building power for the next decade to combat the extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. These new endorsements add to the twenty-seven state legislature candidates that we had previously endorsed through the Democracy Defenders program.
**In Michigan** , as you already know, we're already working to elect two phenomenal Supreme Court justices. And now, with this new round of endorsements, we add focus to the state legislature, too, where we'll help hold the Democratic majority in the House.
If Democrats can keep the House, they'll also keep their Democratic trifecta, which will protect the state's redistricting reform and allow for more landmark policies to protect the freedoms of Michiganders state-wide.
**In Minnesota** , we're also working to protect the Democratic trifecta. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November.
**In New Hampshire** , we're working to help win majorities across the legislature. Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. _The House is considered a toss-up_ and the Senate is within reach.
Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment._Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest._
**And in Wisconsin** , where fair legislative maps are _finally_ a reality, we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly — our best shot in a generation.
For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature, and their reign has been nothing short of disastrous for democracy in the state. Wisconsin deserves better — and our Democracy Defenders can deliver.

With this Democracy Defenders program, we do the work to determine which seats could have an outsized impact against Republican anti-democracy agendas across the country — so that you can make sure your dollars have the most impact this election season. | = These 104 Democracy Defenders — from races in Georgia, Michigan, Minnesota, New Hampshire, and Wisconsin — are dedicated to protecting the fundamental rights of the American people. But with time running out on their campaigns, they need our support today. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = These 104 Democracy Defenders are critical to safeguarding and strengthening democracy: In Georgia , we're building power for the next decade to combat the extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. These new endorsements add to the twenty-seven state legislature candidates that we had previously endorsed through the Democracy Defenders program. In Michigan , as you already know, we're already working to elect two phenomenal Supreme Court justices. And now, with this new round of endorsements, we add focus to the state legislature, too, where we'll help hold the Democratic majority in the House. If Democrats can keep the House, they'll also keep their Democratic trifecta, which will protect the state's redistricting reform and allow for more landmark policies to protect the freedoms of Michiganders state-wide. In Minnesota , we're also working to protect the Democratic trifecta. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November. In New Hampshire , we're working to help win majorities across the legislature. Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. The House is considered a toss-up and the Senate is within reach. Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment.Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. And in Wisconsin , where fair legislative maps are finally a reality, we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly — our best shot in a generation. For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature, and their reign has been nothing short of disastrous for democracy in the state. Wisconsin deserves better — and our Democracy Defenders can deliver. The Democracy Defenders program is meant to shine a spotlight on the local races most important for protecting our democracy. Friends,
I’ve got to tell you – this campaign is ON FIRE .
People are fired up everywhere I go because they see what’s happening in our race.
We have a real shot to kick Jim Jordan out of Congress, and you can feel the excitement not just in Ohio but across the entire country.
Folks from all 50 states are stepping up to contribute and support our campaign because they know what’s at stake.
They see Jim Jordan for what he really is: one of the most dangerous and unhinged politicians of all time .
Seriously, history will put him right up there with Joseph McCarthy and his infamous witch hunts.
But here’s the thing: we can’t leave anything to chance. We’ve got the momentum, but to push through and WIN, we need to hit our $1 million goal for September. Can you chip in today and help us make history? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240922_national_surge_link1]
Let’s be real – Jim Jordan has failed this country time and time again.
He’s done NOTHING to lower the cost of gas or groceries, failed to make healthcare more affordable, and has voted to gut Social Security over and over again.
What an awful record – and that’s not even mentioning the fact that he turned his back on our Constitution when he aided insurrectionists on Jan. 6th and he turned his back on his recruits when he helped cover up the sexual abuse at OSU.
I was born and raised in Ohio. I’m fighting for our families because it’s what I’ve dedicated my life to – a life of public service. I will never turn my back on you.
I know what it's like not having enough money in the bank to pay the next bill, afford groceries, or medicine.
I’ve lived these experiences, and that’s why I’m fighting to deliver real results for all of us – capping prescription drug prices, saving Social Security, and fighting for affordable healthcare.
This is the most important congressional race in the country because WHEN we take out Jordan, we are sending the message that dangerous, traitorous politicians won’t get away with betraying our country.
Let’s keep this national surge going! Contribute now and help us hit our $1 million goal. Together, we’ll take Jordan down and free this country from his tyrannical congressional career. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240922_national_surge_link2]

subject: Bulletproof desks? Not Normal, Our Children Deserve Better
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TN Voter Project; Danielle Inez, Treasurer
body:
https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com]
Dear Friend,
School shootings have tragically become a heartbreaking part of life in America. Already this year, CNN reports there have been dozens of shootings in schools , and now, parents are being forced to buy "bulletproof hoodies" and "hand-held shields" to protect their children. The New York Times recently highlighted how schools are even purchasing bulletproof desks —yes, desks—to shield students from gunfire.
This is not normal , and it should never be accepted as such. Our children deserve classrooms filled with hope, not fear.
At The Tennessee Voter Project , we are working hard to elect leaders who will stand up to the gun lobby and prioritize the safety of our kids. But we need your help . Last week I [wrote how the SAVE Act is the MAGA Republican attempt to revive Jim Crow](https://substack.com/redirect/9c18c1df-b403-4916-9e83-94f760693b68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) voter suppression in America. This Project 2025 priority is already being enacted now in 2024 to help Donald Trump win. I share below the first hand alternate reality in which MAGA Republicans live, in this case, as it relates to voting rights in America. If we have any hope of saving our republic, we cannot just vote this November--we must vote in such overwhelming numbers that we overcome the MAGA attempts to deny voting rights to millions of Americans. **Let 's Address This.**

---|---|---
Voters oppose voter suppression in Georgia 2021. [Credit: Lynn Anderson / AP]
It started with this viral tweet below. And as of the writing of this article this [viral tweet](https://substack.com/redirect/b9c3fe4c-46ed-4ed4-9db8-e39a7f39d3ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) exceeded 20,000 retweets, 54,000 likes, and 2.3 million views: (forgive the misspelling of _eligible_ but such is social media).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68686530-2fd3-427d-a283-1c95d04bc4c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Additionally, the Oklahoma MAGA GOP Governor [purged more than 435,000 voters from the voter rolls](https://substack.com/redirect/1601c330-1d09-46f4-99c0-2567d9e174d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Of them, at least 194,962 voters were valid voters but removed anyway due to made up excuses like 'address verification.' As one among many readers [responded](https://substack.com/redirect/17ed269e-b736-42f3-9ebd-62a06b38ecbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/47054cd4-ce0c-411e-ae9e-74f5386f6a5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While this person has the knowledge and means to check their status, the fact that is that many don't. That is voter suppression. These voters will show up ready to vote like they always do, but be arbitrarily denied due to the above Jim Crow suppression.

Meanwhile, the responses to my tweet from MAGAs spanned from outright disbelief, to claims that none of the above is voter suppression, to accusations that the above is necessary to prevent Democrats from cheating, to grotesque racism. For example, a MAGA named Carl Whitlock accused me of being a "weak little tiny boy" who "supports baby killing," and how only "cheaters" oppose hand counting ballots.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e8a121d6-a1d4-439d-8d58-98ed1bba5aac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But Carl wasn't alone. He was just one of thousands of angry and unhinged responses--virtually none of them grounded in fact. Steve McGraw cited the [debunked "2000 Mules" fascist propaganda](https://substack.com/redirect/630aa1f2-a40d-4fe1-ae11-9c9ac496f052?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) film by disgraced convicted felon Dinesh D'Souza.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6771e073-afe6-4e2f-9667-49e5cd4b97b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Another person named Dr. Sandra, whose bio proudly displays "_Are you good with Christ? Jesus Christ is my Lord and Savior,_ " tweeted the following to me:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc69e92a-6662-4ab5-847d-37f93afb7ce5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
How Christ-like, don't you think? In fact, a significant number of responses from MAGA extremists were just racists and white supremacists telling me to "go back to my sh*thole country." Certainly the argument you make when you stand on facts and logic (sarcasm).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/30d031fd-35c3-4fc0-9700-bf343d4ed141?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Qya5LTsbrIcuHY4sD4gAPC2CdNJPkjB0AIasTHgmRdk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149213275)
The above racism and name calling notwithstanding, the fact is that each of my statements are accurate and MAGA Republicans are in fact trying to steal the 2024 election. For example, I stated, that "_Texas has purged about 500K eligible voters from voter rolls_." In fact, [the full number of purged names exceeds 1 million](https://substack.com/redirect/2d6df936-d09a-49ea-bbea-ad400802d15e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with roughly half of them eligible voters:
> About half of the voters removed have died, requested to be be taken off or are living in another state, based on figures from the governor's office. Nearly 7,000 were noncitizens who had registered illegally, and about 6,000 were convicted felons unable to vote. **About 463,000 were on what Texas calls its["suspense list,"](https://substack.com/redirect/21c7e060-df6f-49c9-ad8c-d7aea33d9fa6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) where counties place voters who don't respond to requested certification forms.** The removal effort is part of a [sweeping package](https://substack.com/redirect/6fe81778-5f3d-43b6-ad71-71c42759520a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of [voting restrictions](https://substack.com/redirect/59286062-b448-46a6-979a-2542124acbba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Texas Legislature passed after the 2020 presidential election.
Note, the "_suspense list_ " has nothing to do with suspicion of illegal or unregistered voting. These are US citizens, already confirmed and registered to vote by showing their ID, and still being purged from the list. As is [well documented](https://substack.com/redirect/1a81dedf-6fee-48da-8094-0f02a86e1819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), this targets low income and people of color more than white people--hence the racist voter suppression.
Next my tweet stated, "_Nebraska is potentially changing its Electoral count to winner take all so they all go Red_." This is a [direct push from Trump to prevent Harris from getting the 1 electoral vote she may need to win the Presidency](https://substack.com/redirect/ca72047b-0485-4169-9098-88799ed7b7b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and it's being done as a last minute effort to further suppress the will of the American people.
Third, my tweet stated that, "Georgia is requiring 5-6M votes be counted by hand." This is [another Trump push](https://substack.com/redirect/33f4aecb-7ecf-40fa-bf47-c0c7aea47123?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to get the "12,000 votes" he needed to win in 2020, and deeply problematic. While MAGAs seem to believe that hand counting votes ensures accuracy, the facts tell a wholly different picture. A detailed MIT study [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/a04fb038-1fa3-483a-9e08-7877c87dd697?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> MIT released a study analyzing elections in New Hampshire from 1946 to 2002, finding poll workers who counted ballots by hand were off by 8%, while voting machines had an error rate of about 0.5%.
Numerous studies consistently arrive at the same conclusion as the above MIT study:
> A 2018 MIT [study](https://substack.com/redirect/c4d6252f-2230-4e16-8e58-88c9229a3bbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that analyzed votes in Wisconsin's 2011 Supreme Court election--which included a recount of ballots tallied by hand and by machines--found that scanners were closer to the recount totals than the hand-counted ballots.
And yet again:
> Another [study](https://substack.com/redirect/b7b99fec-2ee9-423c-8d83-d1fdb9bd575a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) published in 2008 by Rice University found that hand-counting ballots produces more errors than machine tabulation, indicating people counting by hand were correct less than 58% of the time.
So not only is it clear that machine tabulation is faster and far more accurate than hand tabulation, there is likewise zero evidence that machine counting has resulted in any form of voter or election fraud. It is no wonder that [Donald Trump shut down his own "voter fraud commission" after finding no such evidence](https://substack.com/redirect/5d76aa60-3033-4d29-a6b1-62987a7af008?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Moreover, Trump then set up a second commission to "find" voter fraud, [but then also shut it down after it found no such fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/586b8959-09db-423a-b444-2352b983fea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Qya5LTsbrIcuHY4sD4gAPC2CdNJPkjB0AIasTHgmRdk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149213275)
Finally, my tweet stated that "_Red states have closed more than 10,000 polling locations in Black/Latino neighborhoods_." On this point I concede I was _not_ accurate, and admit I erroneously missed a 0. In reality, Red states have closed not 10,000, but [more than 100,000 polling locations](https://substack.com/redirect/84c42736-8a43-4bf0-8950-b931025ba843?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), disproportionately in Black and Latino neighborhoods. Yes, _100,000+ closed polling locations_.
> National data from the independent, nonpartisan U.S. Election Assistance Commission shows declining polling place availability nationwide. A [2018 survey](https://substack.com/redirect/69cd470f-1abc-43b2-93de-8689db0fd8cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found more than 200,000 polling places in use. That number dropped to just over 132,000 [in 2020's report](https://substack.com/redirect/479d9069-b1e9-4c37-9b4d-6398f7c3bb05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and fell again to [94,793](https://substack.com/redirect/c8dbdf94-48fd-4b3c-a36b-c576f31746e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) physical polling places in 2022. Fewer places to cast a ballot can be a barrier to voting for many people, especially low-income individuals who may lack transportation or time off to vote.
Shutting down more than half of all polling locations, while zero demonstrable election fraud exists, is what voters suppression looks like. Texas is one of the worst offenders, and overtly racist in how they closed locations. A Guardian analysis found [that](https://substack.com/redirect/704cf842-aa0b-4512-b9a2-5dff994be4f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The 50 counties that gained the most Black and Latinx residents between 2012 and 2018 closed 542 polling sites, compared to just 34 closures in the 50 counties that have gained the fewest black and Latinx residents. This is despite the fact that the population in the former group of counties has risen by 2.5 million people, whereas in the latter category the total population has fallen by over 13,000.
As a reminder, a Washington Post and AP study [over the last 50 years found no examples of systemic voter fraud, and no examples of voter fraud that could have even remotely overturned any State or Federal election](https://substack.com/redirect/da35c3dc-140a-4b9a-8ba3-c365aa5b45c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). We must say it plainly. Republicans know they cannot win on ideas and policy, so they are engaging in demonization and voter suppression to steal the 2024 election. And the response to those, like myself and my other human rights lawyers and activists calling out this injustice, is overt racism and bigotry. But we will not be silenced so easily.
It is impossible to overstate how critical it is we vote in overwhelming numbers this November up and down the ballot. MAGA Republicans are screaming loudly that they have no regard for democracy or a government represented by We the People. We should believe them, and vote to ensure they never have that kind of power again.

Fellow Patriot,

---
**_I’m not asking for money, just your signature._**

**You may not know me, so let me share my story.**

I owe my life to this country.

My family escaped Vietnam before it fell to the communists when I was four years old, and even though America was unfamiliar at first, in no time, it became my home.

As I grew up, I learned that we owed our lives to the freedoms in this country. That’s why I decided to dedicate my life to serving it.

**My family and I might not be alive if it wasn’t for the greatest nation on Earth, and I had to repay America the best way I could. I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and went on to serve for 25 years, retiring as a Navy Captain in some of the most dangerous corners of the Earth.**

When I was in the Navy, I saw the very best of humanity that America has to offer. _And when I compare it to the_ _“leadership” we see in Washington today, I can’t help but feel we’re missing something._

**It’s no coincidence that as people are losing trust in our elected officials, veteran representation in Congress is at an all-time low.**

_I’m on a mission to change that._

**My name is Hung Cao, and I’m running for the U.S. Senate because America needs veterans in Washington more than ever.**

Team, this is just another of a dozen attacks Trump has thrown my way.
“Watermelon head,” “Pencil neck,” “Fat ugly face,” “Shifty Schiff,” the list goes on.
But that wasn’t all. He also cast doubt on California elections, saying that my opponent, Steve Garvey, would win if we had an honest election. There he goes again — setting up another big lie for when he and Garvey lose.
_Heck, if he spent half the time he does on big lies and insults, he might have more than just “concepts of plans” to talk about on the campaign trail!_
But he doesn’t. Because this is classic Donald Trump. All flash and entertainment, insults and attacks to get another cable news hit — with no substance or plans to deliver for the people of California.
And these relentless attacks on me are a part of his campaign strategy to win in November. **Trump and his enablers focus their attacks on me because they know that no one has been more effective at holding him accountable for his lies and misdeeds, and nothing infuriates his supporters more than the reminder of how I stood up to him.**
In the House, I impeached him and served on the Select Committee on the January 6 Attack. **In the Senate, I’ll keep fighting his assaults on our democracy and hold his biggest enablers accountable.**
His obsession is the highest compliment — _it means I’m doing my job._

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1959%2E135344%2E4t_F8A)

Friend --
In just a few days, we’ll close the books on the last official quarterly FEC deadline of our campaign.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate is one of the most strategic contributions you can make today.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign.
There is no winning the White House without Michigan. For Democrats, there is no holding the Senate without Michigan. Even our House delegation rests on a one-seat Democratic majority.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running -- in fact, it’s one of the few competitive races in the entire country. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state across our 11 media markets.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.
Add the fact that this is already one of the most expensive races in the country -- not just with candidate spending, but outside spending too.
And I'll close with the news that in all of my elections, I have historically done better than Democrats usually do in the "redder" areas of the state. That means I am finding and pulling voters other races couldn't, and that is good for everyone up and down the ballot on Election Day.
So yes, this race is kind of a unicorn. It's a unique situation where control of the White House and Congress is on the line, most voters don't know the candidates yet, and the Democratic Senate candidate can help the top of the ticket, and not the other way around.
[**That's why I am asking for your support: Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate before our September FEC fundraising drive ends? I would not ask if it were not so important.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240922-3-900&t=2&akid=1959%2E135344%2E4t_F8A)

subject: It’s been a tough week
body:
But I’m also grateful.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93359445/500213637/-1463099547?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjM4MWYxYTktMjU3OS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1szhaAOa7wMciOYSUQ5E0QQLsef1ppVmUngIvdOo_wY=) | It’s been a really tough week, Peter. Honestly, probably one of the toughest I’ve had in this job. First, a GOP special interest group launched a TV ad for our opponent. That forced us to go up with our own ad weeks before we had the budget to do so. Then, I got a text that our campaign signs were vandalized... with a chainsaw! **We’re a bit shaken up, but I’m genuinely in awe of the resilience of this team. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: My heart aches for Birmingham, Alabama
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
Last night should have been a fun night out for members of the Birmingham, Alabama community. Instead, it turned into a night of bloodshed and terror when multiple shooters opened fire at a major nightlife hub. Four people were killed and at least seventeen more were injured.
My heart aches for the victims of this horrific tragedy and for all of the survivors who must now live with the trauma from this violence. Everyone in our nation deserves the freedom to have a night out with friends without worrying that they might get shot.
Unfortunately, this is not the first time that the Birmingham community has experienced a mass shooting. Alabama has the fourth-highest gun death rate in the nation, and some of the weakest gun laws in the country.
It is absolutely unacceptable that Alabama lawmakers do not do more to curb the state’s gun violence crisis. We must all come together to keep the pressure on Alabama elected officials to **_do something.**_
Alabamians deserve to live without the fear of gun violence. I will not rest in our work here at GIFFORDS until that future becomes a reality in Alabama, and in every state across our nation.
Please, keep standing with me in this fight.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords
* * *

**GIFFORDS PAC works to end gun violence by empowering voters with information and supporting candidates who will fight for safer gun laws. A contribution to GIFFORDS PAC goes directly towards our work to save lives.**

Straight from Vice President Kamala Harris during her recent trip to Georgia, Team:
" Leaders here who have a continuing conversation — a conversation that many of us have been having for years — around the significance of fighting for basic and fundamental freedoms, the promise of our country, and in particular the right to vote and having access to the ballot and ensuring that access in times where there are, I believe, intentional, full-on attempts to make it more difficult for people to vote so that they will not vote.
When we look at the state of Georgia, in many ways, it is ground zero on this issue, both in terms of Georgia’s history of fighting for the right of people to express their dreams and goals for their country through the exercise of their right to vote . "
We couldn't have said it better -- Georgia will be one focus of our fight to make every voice heard and every vote count in this critical election year.

This is one of our most critical fundraising moments, so can you donate $25 for the first time today? If you’ve been waiting for the best time to chip in your first $25, that time is NOW. We can defeat Donald Trump, but only if we work together. And we’re counting on YOU to chip in and help us do it. DEFEND DEMOCRACY, DEFEND FREEDOM
Your Freedoms Are at Risk—
Take Action Now!
Dear Peter,
Our civil liberties are hanging by a thread, and I need to speak with you about what’s at stake.
These are the fundamental rights guaranteed by the Bill of Rights: freedom of speech, the press, worship, peaceable assembly, the right to bear arms, trial by jury, and protection from government overreach.
[Without these, there is no democracy.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_21_24_all_1&n=5)
[Democracy isn’t just about voting – **it’s about being a truly free and empowered citizen.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_21_24_all_1&n=6)
Right now, these freedoms are under assault like never before, and time is running out to take action. I ran for President to restore these essential rights, and **while I’ve suspended my campaign, the fight is far from over.**
Both President Trump and I have felt the crushing force of government censorship, surveillance, and propaganda. We know firsthand what it’s like to face these threats. That’s why I’m continuing this fight alongside him – _but I cannot do it alone_.
[This is no longer just about a campaign for the presidency. It’s about fighting for the issues that matter most – **civil liberties, peace, freedom, and health.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_21_24_all_1&n=7)
Every minute counts. If you care about protecting your freedoms as much as I do, please [**donate right now**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em-cl?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=civil_liberties_9_21_24_all_1&n=8). Your support is crucial to keeping this movement alive and defending the rights of every American.

clean_body: We must step back from the brink – now. | | | | | | | DEFEND DEMOCRACY, DEFEND FREEDOM Your Freedoms Are at Risk— Take Action Now! Dear Peter, Our civil liberties are hanging by a thread, and I need to speak with you about what’s at stake. These are the fundamental rights guaranteed by the Bill of Rights: freedom of speech, the press, worship, peaceable assembly, the right to bear arms, trial by jury, and protection from government overreach. Right now, these freedoms are under assault like never before, and time is running out to take action. I ran for President to restore these essential rights, and while I’ve suspended my campaign, the fight is far from over. Both President Trump and I have felt the crushing force of government censorship, surveillance, and propaganda. We know firsthand what it’s like to face these threats. That’s why I’m continuing this fight alongside him – but I cannot do it alone. Every minute counts. If you care about protecting your freedoms as much as I do, please . Your support is crucial to keeping this movement alive and defending the rights of every American. Will you give now to help me keep this fight going? We don’t have time to waste. to contribute whatever you can. Together, we will make sure our civil liberties are defended.. | | Robert F. subject: Why I got into public service

body:
Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important.
**When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition."
Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that.
**Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.**
Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.
The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter.

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: The dark scandal that should end Jim Jordan’s career
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Jim Jordan is nothing but a coward who turned his back on abuse victims not once, not twice, but OVER AND OVER AGAIN.
During his time as an assistant wrestling coach at Ohio State University, multiple athletes came to Jordan, begging for help to stop the sexual abuse they were suffering at the hands of the team doctor, Richard Strauss.
Some of these young men were Jordan’s own recruits. They trusted him and pleaded for protection from their abuser.
But Jim Jordan did NOTHING.
He let these young men be abused, ignored their pleas, and protected the abuser instead of the students. And it didn’t end there.
Years later, when these same men came to their congressman – the very man who failed them the first time – looking for support in their decades-long quest for justice, Jordan turned his back on them again.
Jim Jordan has never once checked in on these survivors, never offered them help or support. In fact, when the breaking story threatened his political career – he tried to pressure them into changing their story!

Why?
Because Jim Jordan only cares about protecting himself – even if that means enabling abusers and protecting predators.
We are so close to kicking Jim Jordan out of office, but only if we make sure enough voters know about what he’s done. We need you to chip in $25, $50, $3,300 or whatever you can right now to help us keep exposing Jordan’s disgusting record of silence. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240922_osu_students_link1]
Jim Jordan’s conduct, then and now, speaks volumes about his character and how he handles himself under pressure. The wrestlers said it best, he’s a coward.
Funny, people tell me all the time that I am brave and courageous. Former male colleagues of mine (pardon me) used to tell me that I have balls of steel. Ha!
Mr. “Lead Investigator” Jordan couldn’t be bothered to investigate abuse that happened right under his own nose, to students under his care, but he’ll run sham investigations to protect sexual predators like Donald Trump.
We made national headlines when we stood alongside these survivors during our “Fire Jim Jordan” action at the DNC.
The response was incredible – people across the country are seeing who Jim Jordan really is.
I’ve spent years fighting for abuse survivors, and I’m already delivering results.
I’m currently working with lawmakers in DC to get my first bill introduced – The Comprehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act .
And guess what? I’m not even elected yet, and I’m doing more for survivors than Jim Jordan has done in his entire 17 years in Congress.
While Jordan’s out there protecting predators, I focus on delivering justice and accountability for the people who need it most.
This is the most important congressional race in the country because it’s about more than politics – it’s about protecting vulnerable people from the predators Jordan shields.
And we know the ULTRA-MAGA world is filled with them, and it starts at the top of the ticket with Donald Trump.
Together, we can finally kick this dangerous man out of Congress, deliver the House for Harris/Walz, and end ULTRA-MAGA’s reign of abusive terror. Join our fight today and help us bring real justice and accountability back to our politics in Washington. Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
